unit: CH-03 F116 - three-site structural closeout and semantic residue search

post_card:140.architectureFinding: The `_readNestedString` path resolver was NOT a generic JSON utility. Its ONLY two call sites in the entire repository were inside `viewerIdentityProvider`, and both were person identity: it tried `id`/`user.id`/`profile.id`, then `handle`/`user.handle`/`profile.handle`. It was a PRIVATE PERSON PARSER wearing a helper's clothes - the F057 defect class, rebuilt locally, one level of indirection away from being recognisable.
post_card:140.privateModelFound: `_ViewerIdentity` (id + handle) - a renamed person reference subset feeding `_isOwnPost` and the card build.
post_card:140.action: `viewerIdentityProvider` now returns `AuraPersonIdentity?`; `_ViewerIdentity` DELETED; `_readNestedString` DELETED as dead. `_isOwnPost` compares against `viewer.userId` / `viewer.handle`.
post_card:140.polymorphicActorQuestion: PostCard's AUTHOR is polymorphic (person or institution) and was left untouched - only the VIEWER, who is always a person, was migrated. No person semantics were forced onto an institution actor, and no new post-local identity type was created.

author_profile_screen:471.defect: If the payload was not nested exactly that way it resolved nothing, and 'am I looking at my own profile?' silently answered NO - the F057 shape.
author_profile_screen:471.action: Reads the canonical model; `viewerId` / `viewerHandle` derive from it. Profile-domain state untouched.

followers_screen:47.source: `authMeDataProvider`, with a nested-or-flat guess `(user is Map ? user['handle'] : me['handle'])`.
followers_screen:47.defect: A second, weaker copy of what the canonical reader already does - one field is still a competing identity authority.
followers_screen:47.action: Reads the canonical model. Follow/relationship state untouched.

semanticResidueSearch.method: Repository-wide scan of lib/ for raw person-field map reads - ['displayName'], ['handle'], ['avatarUrl'], ['photoUrl'], ['fullName'] - excluding route parameters and comments.
semanticResidueSearch.whereTheyAre: Almost all sit inside TYPED DOMAIN MODELS - /domain/ files, *_repository.dart, *_models.dart - which the detector classifies as TYPED_DESERIALIZATION_BOUNDARY and therefore does NOT count as gate debt.
semanticResidueSearch.theHonestFinding: MATERIAL. The previous pass classified those TYPES as legitimate different-domain concepts, which remains true of the types. But their PARSING is still independent person interpretation, and several carry their own competing fallback chains - `m['displayName'] ?? m['name'] ?? handle` (post_model), `_readString(j['displayName']) ?? _readString(j['name'])` (feed/domain/post), `m['avatarUrl'] ?? m['avatar'] ?? m['imageUrl']` (post_model), and a `'Guest'` fallback in meeting_identity.
semanticResidueSearch.consequence: Criterion 2 is NOT met. The client's SURFACES have converged; the client's TYPED BOUNDARIES have not. Reporting criterion 2 as met on the strength of three cleared detector rows would have been false - the search exists precisely to prevent that.

f116ClosureTest.2_clientDeserializationConverges: NOT MET - structural residue named and measured: 63 typed boundaries still deserialise person fields independently, several with their own fallback chains.
f116ClosureTest.3_duplicateFallbackSemanticsEliminated: MET AT THE SURFACE LAYER; NOT MET inside the typed boundaries, where private alias and fallback chains survive.
f116ClosureTest.4_privateDuplicateModelsDeletedOrCompose: MET - `_ViewerIdentity` was the last private person MODEL found; it is gone.
f116ClosureTest.verdict: F116 REMAINS PARTIALLY_VALIDATED. Not for lack of classification, and not for a cosmetic count - for a named structural residue: person deserialisation is converged at the surface and not yet at the typed boundary.

f053Reassessment.sameSurfaceNamedDifferently: Not through a surface-owned fallback any more. Still possible through two different typed boundaries parsing the same person - e.g. a feed post author and an article author use different alias orders.
f053Reassessment.handleAvatarNameFromCompetingSources: At the surface, no. Through domain models, yes.
f053Reassessment.inventedLabelsForIdentifiablePeople: None found at any migrated surface. One survives inside a typed boundary: meeting_identity's `'Guest'` default.
f053Reassessment.faceWithoutIdentity: Prevented by the canonical reader wherever it is used.
f053Reassessment.personVsInstitutionDistinct: Preserved - several remaining measured sites are institution identity precisely because the two were kept apart.
f053Reassessment.verdict: F053 REMAINS PARTIALLY_VALIDATED. Its residue is the same residue as F116 criterion 2, stated in visible terms: two domain models can still name one person differently.

remainderByCategory.governedBackendExceptions: 2 - auth credential/verification reads, unchanged and deliberately still measured
remainderByCategory.specializedCircleAvatarPresentation: 15 - render a person from already-resolved typed/form/meeting values; identity semantics already canonical; presentation-class debt, not identity-semantic debt
remainderByCategory.detectorDomainNoise: 9 - institution name (2), institution actor (1), institution logo (2), institution slug (1), external TikTok account label (3). NOT person identity.

detectorRefinementQuestion.status: PRESERVED FOR A SEPARATE RULING - deliberately not answered here.
detectorRefinementQuestion.question: Should a PERSON-identity conformance detector distinguish person identity from institution identity and from external-platform account identity, rather than flagging the field names displayName / handle / avatarUrl / slug regardless of domain?
detectorRefinementQuestion.evidence: 9 of the 26 measured sites are known non-person domain matches. They inflate a person-identity metric with institution and third-party-account data.
detectorRefinementQuestion.whatWasNotDone: No regex narrowed, no exclusion added, no institution or TikTok field suppressed, no historical baseline semantics altered.
detectorRefinementQuestion.secondQuestionRaisedByThisPass: Whether TYPED_DESERIALIZATION_BOUNDARY should become gate debt once a canonical client model exists. It was excluded when there was no alternative to a private typed boundary; now there is one, and the exclusion is what makes criterion 2's residue invisible to the ratchet.

otherFindings.F052: No new evidence this pass; state unchanged.
otherFindings.F054/F055/F056/F057: Unchanged. F057's defect class was found AGAIN inside post_card and eliminated, which supports rather than changes its recorded state.
otherFindings.F051: UNTOUCHED. No CircleAvatar was migrated; the chat-avatar question is not adjudicated.

verification.backend: UNTOUCHED - no backend production code needed modification
verification.identityConformanceGate: PASS at the new baseline 14 files / 26 sites

founderDecisionsRequired: TWO instrument questions preserved for a separate ruling, stated above - domain-aware detection, and whether typed boundaries should now count as debt.
